cando: I can greet people, react to news and make small talk.
I can talk about my weekend, trips, people and places, and compare things.
I can make plans, invite people, order in a café and ask the way.
cando_ar: أستطيع أن أحيّي الآخرين وأتفاعل مع الأخبار وأتبادل أحاديث قصيرة.
أستطيع أن أتحدث عن عطلتي ورحلاتي وعن الأشخاص والأماكن، وأن أقارن بين الأشياء.
أستطيع أن أرتّب المواعيد وأوجّه الدعوات وأطلب في المقهى وأسأل عن الطريق.

cards.q: Hey! How are you doing?
a: I'm doing well, thanks. How about you?
Not bad, but I'm a little tired today.

cards.ar: خمني! فزت بالمركز الأول في معرض العلوم!
cards.q: Guess what? I won first place at the science fair!
a: Really? That's great news!
Wow, congratulations! You worked so hard.

cards.q: Oh no, I lost my phone at the mall yesterday!
a: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Did you find it?
Oh no, that's terrible! Did you ask at the information desk?

cards.q: You meet a friend after the summer break.
steps: She says she went to AlUla. React.
a: Hi! It's so good to see you!
How was your summer?
Really? That's amazing!
Guess what? I learned to swim!

cards.q: What did you do last weekend?
a: I visited my grandparents, and we had dinner together.
I stayed at home and watched a documentary.

cards.q: Did you go out on Friday?
a: Yes, we went to a new café downtown.
No, I didn't. I was too tired.

cards.q: Did you finish your homework over the weekend?
a: Yes, I finished it on Saturday morning.
Not all of it. I still have to do the math.

cards.q: Tell your teacher about your weekend.
a: On Friday, I went to our farm.
I went with my cousins.
We had a barbecue and played games.
It was really relaxing.

cards.ar: إلى أين ذهبتِ في آخر رحلة؟
cards.q: Where did you go on your last trip?
a: We went to Jeddah to visit my aunt.
We went to Makkah for Umrah. It was a beautiful trip.

cards.q: How did you get to Jeddah?
a: We drove. It took about ten hours!
We flew. The flight was only an hour and a half.

cards.q: Have you been to Abha?
a: Yes, I have. We went there last summer.
No, I haven't, but I'd love to go.

cards.ar: حدّثي صديقتك عن رحلة لا تنسينها.
cards.q: Tell a friend about a trip you remember.
steps: Say where and when you went.
Say what you did after that.
a: Two years ago, we went to AlUla.
First, we visited Hegra.
After that, we had dinner under the stars.
I felt so happy. It was amazing!

cards.q: What does your best friend look like?
a: She's tall, and she has long black hair.
She's not very tall. She has brown eyes and wears glasses.

cards.q: What's your mom like?
a: She's really kind and patient.
She's strict, but she's very funny.

cards.q: Who do you look like in your family?
a: I look like my mother. We have the same eyes.
People say I look like my aunt.

cards.q: Describe someone you admire.
a: My aunt is a doctor.
She's tall, and she wears glasses.
She's very patient and funny.
I admire her because she helps a lot of people.

cards.q: What's your neighborhood like?
a: It's quiet, and there are lots of trees.
It's busy and noisy, but it has everything.

cards.ar: ما أفضل مكان تذهبين إليه في مدينتك؟
cards.q: What's the best place to go in your city?
a: I think the big park is the best. It's great for walking.
The mall! There are lots of shops and cafés.

cards.q: How far is your school from your house?
a: It's about ten minutes by car.
It's far. It takes about half an hour.

cards.q: Tell a visitor about your city.
steps: Say what your city is like.
Say one place she should visit.
a: I live in ___.
It's a big, busy city.
You should visit the old market.
It's great for buying gifts.

cards.ar: أيهما أفضل: المذاكرة في البيت أم في المكتبة؟
cards.q: Which is better, studying at home or at the library?
a: The library is better. It's quieter.
I think home is better because it's more comfortable.

cards.q: Is it cheaper to shop online?
a: Yes, it's usually cheaper and easier.
Not always. Sometimes the stores are cheaper.

cards.q: What's the most difficult subject for you?
a: Physics is the most difficult for me.
Math, but it's also the most interesting!

cards.q: Compare two cities you know.
steps: Say which one is more beautiful.
Say which one you like more and why.
a: Riyadh is bigger than Abha.
Riyadh is much hotter in summer.
But Abha is more beautiful.
I like Abha more because it's cooler and greener.

cards.q: What are you going to do this weekend?
a: I'm going to visit my cousins.
I'm not sure yet. Maybe I'll just stay home.

cards.ar: لماذا لا نذهب إلى محل الكتب الجديد يوم السبت؟
cards.q: Why don't we go to the new bookstore on Saturday?
a: Good idea! What time?
I'd love to, but I can't on Saturday. How about Sunday evening?

cards.q: Where should we meet?
a: Let's meet at the café near the mall.
How about the main entrance at four o'clock?

cards.q: Plan a study afternoon with a friend.
a: Why don't we study together for the math test?
How about Thursday at four?
Let's meet at the library.
Don't forget to bring your notes!

cards.ar: هل تودين المجيء إلى بيتنا للغداء يوم الجمعة؟
cards.q: Would you like to come over for lunch on Friday?
a: Yes, I'd love to! What time?
Thanks for asking, but I can't. We're visiting my aunt.

cards.q: Those bags look heavy. Can I help you?
a: Yes, please. That's very kind of you.
No, it's OK, thanks. I can carry them.

cards.ar: سأذهب إلى المقصف. هل تريدين أي شيء؟
cards.q: I'm going to the cafeteria. Do you want anything?
a: Yes, please! Could you get me an orange juice?
No, thanks. I'm fine.

cards.ar: ادعي صديقتك إلى حفل تخرج أختك.
cards.q: Invite a friend to your sister's graduation party.
a: Would you like to come to my sister's graduation party?
It's on Thursday at eight.
It's at our house.
We can pick you up, if you like.

cards.q: Hi! What can I get you?
a: Could I have a large iced latte, please?
I'll have a small hot chocolate and a cookie, please.

cards.q: For here or to go?
a: To go, please.
For here, please. Can I also have some water?

cards.q: Would you like to try it on?
a: Yes, please. Where are the fitting rooms?
No, thanks. I'll just take it.

cards.q: Buy sneakers at the mall.
a: Hi, I'm looking for white sneakers.
Do you have these in a size thirty-eight?
How much are they?
Can I pay by card?

cards.q: Excuse me, how do I get to the food court, please?
a: Go up the escalator and turn left.
Go straight, and it's on your right, next to the bookstore.
cards.ask: the way to the food court?

cards.q: How do you usually get around the city?
a: My mom usually drives me.
We often take the metro. It's fast and cheap.

cards.q: Good morning. Where are you traveling to?
a: Two tickets to Makkah, please.
One ticket to Madinah, please. What time is the next train?

cards.q: A visitor asks you the way to the museum.
steps: Tell her to take the metro.
a: First, take the metro from here.
Then get off at the third stop.
After that, turn right and go straight.
It takes about fifteen minutes.

cards.q: Eid Mubarak!
a: Eid Mubarak! Happy Eid to you and your family.
Thank you! Eid Mubarak to you too!

cards.q: What do you usually do in Ramadan?
a: I help my mom with iftar, and I read the Quran.
We usually have iftar at my grandmother's house.

cards.ar: هل ستسافرون في العيد هذا العام؟
cards.q: Are you going to travel for Eid this year?
a: Yes, we're going to Madinah to visit my grandparents.
No, we're going to stay home this year.

cards.q: Tell your teacher about last Eid.
steps: Say what the best part was.
a: Last Eid, we were at my grandparents' house.
I wore a new green dress.
We visited all our aunts and uncles.
The best part was the big family lunch.

cards.q: What kind of books do you like?
a: I love mystery stories because they're exciting.
I prefer true stories about famous people.

cards.q: Do you like online classes?
a: Not really. I prefer being in class with my friends.
Yes, I do, because I can study at my own pace.

cards.ar: ما الشيء الذي لا تحبين فعله؟
cards.q: What's something you don't like doing?
a: I don't like waking up early, especially on weekends.
I'm not a big fan of shopping. It's so tiring!

cards.q: Tell a friend about a hobby you love.
steps: Say one thing you don't like about it.
a: I love taking photos of nature.
I started when I was twelve.
I like it because it helps me remember special days.
But I don't like editing them. It takes so long!
